svg.title: ROLLCALL's roll book: every app answers
svg.desc: A page of the roll book: 17 sample apps called down the register one at a time, each answered with a stamp. 7 present, 5 late, 4 back row, 1 inaudible. Sample data · fictional apps · policy as of 2026-10-28.

text.font-family: 'Libre Caslon Display', 'Libre Caslon Text', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

svg.text: Sample data · fictional apps · policy as of 2026-10-28
MIDDLE ROWS PHP 8.3 and 8.2, security fixes only
BACK ROW past end of life

g.text: Nobody is marked absent. If one source has a gap, like a missing PROCTOR report or a bad image tag, that app gets a note and the scan carries on.
